note: Fully first-principles invented retrieval stack running natively in Rust CHORUS (ChorusField::recall_maxsim). Reverse-engineered replacements for the three borrowed IR techniques, each brain + information-theory grounded, honestly measured. Scored honest raw: a gold dia_id counts only if that exact turn is retrieved into top-k. No neighbor expansion.

invented_stack.alignment: salience-gated MaxSim — query tokens weighted by divergence from the query centroid (predictive coding; downweights [CLS]/[SEP]/function tokens). Replaces plain ColBERT MaxSim.
invented_stack.lexical: conjunctive surprisal — info content -log(p(t)) x saturating neural response (1-e^-tf/tau, Weber-Fechner), plus proximity-bound bonus for co-occurring rare terms (conjunctive binding). Replaces BM25, zero ad-hoc constants.
invented_stack.fusion: evidence integration — z-score each channel, reliability-weighted sum (Ernst-Banks optimal cue combination). Replaces RRF rank heuristic; preserves score magnitude.
